name: Word behind you
what: A giant word stands in the room behind you: its letters drop in one after another with a small settle, it drifts slowly larger while it holds (optionally glowing, the room dimmed), then the letters lift away. The Editor puts it behind the person and moves it with the camera.
origin: MotionLab's own build of a common in-shot effect for talking-head videos: a giant word behind the speaker (2026-10-27)
motion: f1-f22 the letters drop from 0.42 em above, one every 1.6 f at most, 15 f each (decelerating with a small overshoot, blurred while they fall); the room dims f0-f9 when dim is on; the word drifts 3.5 % larger and 10 px higher over the hold (S-curve), its glow breathing every 48 f; the last 12-16 f the letters lift 0.3 em and fade (accelerating), one after another

tracks.name: letters drop
tracks.what: the letters drop in one after another and settle

tracks.what: the word drifts slowly larger and higher
